mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_book ( user_id, seq_no, author, title, buy_date, complete_date, genre_id, img_url, info_url, memo, price, published, publisher, rate ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{seqNo}, #{author}, #{title}, #{buyDate}, #{completeDate}, #{genreId}, #{imgUrl}, #{infoUrl}, #{memo}, #{price}, #{published}, #{publisher}, #{rate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_book SET author = #{author}, title = #{title}, buy_date = #{buyDate}, complete_date = #{completeDate}, genre_id = #{genreId}, img_url = #{imgUrl}, info_url = #{infoUrl}, memo = #{memo}, price = #{price}, published = #{published}, publisher = #{publisher}, rate = #{rate} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND seq_no = #{seqNo}
